messages:
Priya (CS): Lumena Health returned our onboarding security questionnaire with five quick asks. They want short, non-technical responses we can include in their vendor portal. Need a reply thats customer-friendly and cleared by security/legal by EOD.

Noah (Infra): Share the exact questions and Ill draft infra-friendly lines.

Priya (CS): Paste of the vendor items:

```
1) Where is data stored (primary regions)?
2) Are data and model artifacts encrypted at rest and what KMS options exist?
3) Do Redwood engineers ever access production data in non-prod environments?
4) Retention windows for embeddings and API logs
5) How to request SOC2 evidence / DPA attachments
```

Noah (Infra): Suggested short answers:
- Regions: Hosted accounts default to US (us-west-2); EU-hosted option (eu-west-1) is available for customers needing EU residency. Dedicated/Private placements can be provisioned in customer-preferred regions.
- Encryption/KMS: All stored data is encrypted at rest (AES-256). For Dedicated or Private deployments we support customer-managed keys (BYOK) via cloud KMS (AWS/GCP) and HSM-backed keys on request. Key rotation follows our standard rotation policy (90 days) unless a different schedule is contracted.
- Access to non-prod: We do not use production customer data in internal development environments except when explicitly approved. Approved snapshots are delivered via a controlled, time-limited workflow with manager approval, just-in-time access, and full audit logging.
- Retention: Default retention for embeddings is 14 days and API logs are retained 90 days for operational troubleshooting. Retention windows are configurable per-tenant for Dedicated/Private customers.
- Evidence: We can provide a redacted SOC2 report and the DPA excerpt. For detailed artifacts (network/data flow diagrams, key provenance) we will coordinate via our secure evidence transfer.

Sasha - Security: A few wording notes for customer-facing copy: replace "we do not use production customer data" with "we do not use production customer data in internal developer environments unless explicitly approved and tightly controlled." Add "access is reviewed periodically and recorded in audit pipelines" to the access bullet. For KMS mention "HSM-backed on request" only when asked.

Felix (Legal): Confirmed. For evidence delivery, point them to the secure-share link (secure-share.redwood/soc2) and note that attachments will be redacted. Do not include internal hostnames or IPs in any diagrams we send. Also avoid committing to any specific retention beyond what we can change via contract.

Priya (CS): Draft reply to customer (for review):

"Thanks for the questionnaire  below are brief answers you can copy into your vendor portal:

1) Regions: Hosted accounts default to the US (us-west-2). EU-hosted deployments are available (eu-west-1) for customers requiring EU residency. Dedicated and Private deployments can be located in your preferred region.

2) Encryption & KMS: All stored data and model artifacts are encrypted at rest (AES-256). For Dedicated/Private customers we support customer-managed keys (BYOK) via cloud KMS (AWS/GCP) and can use HSM-backed keys where required. We operate a key-rotation policy (standard 90 days) unless otherwise agreed.

3) Non-production access: We do not use production customer data in internal developer environments unless explicitly approved and tightly controlled. When a customer-approved snapshot is required, access is granted through an approval workflow, limited to authorized personnel, and recorded in audit logs; access is reviewed periodically.

4) Retention: By default embeddings are retained for 14 days and API logs for 90 days for operational troubleshooting. Retention windows can be adjusted per contract or for Dedicated/Private customers.

5) Evidence: We can provide a redacted SOC2 report and a DPA excerpt. For additional artifacts (network diagrams, key provenance) we will coordinate delivery via our secure evidence transfer. Please let us know which attachments youd like and well initiate the secure share.

"

Noah (Infra): Id add "recorded in audit logs" was good. Also can add the KMS rotation snippet if you want a short policy paragraph.

Sasha - Security: LGTM with the access review sentence. If they ask about human review of outputs, we should state "we do not perform human review of model outputs unless explicitly enabled by the customer."

Felix (Legal): Approve to send once the SOC2 redacted PDF is attached via secure-share. Priya, avoid attaching internal diagrams directly in Slack.

Priya (CS): Thanks all  will attach the redacted SOC2 and DPA excerpt via secure-share and send to Lumena. Tagging @evidence-bot to log the evidence transfer task. :white_check_mark:

evidence-bot: Task logged: "Lumena vendor questionnaire response & SOC2 transfer"; owner: Priya (CS); due: 2026-04-01T18:00:00Z; ref: onboarding/Lumena/ev-2026.

Noah (Infra): Sending KMS rotation paragraph here for copy/paste: "By default, cryptographic keys are rotated every 90 days. We support customer-defined rotation schedules for BYOK-managed keys and can provide rotation logs on request via secure evidence transfer."

Priya (CS): Perfect  including that. Ill post final message to Lumena in the next hour and update the onboarding board.
